tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i mdo'i don nyams su len tshul bsod nams kyi 'byung gnas chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i mdo'i don nyams su len tshul bsod nams kyi 'byung gnas chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i mdo'i don nyams su len tshul bsod nams kyi 'byung gnas chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

ston pa thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i mdo'i don nyams su len tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po la yul ni ltung bshags kyi mjug tu'am/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa'i mdun nam/ 'jug pa med pa ni rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dmigs yul du byas te dad pa shugs drag pos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams la nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa na mchod pa'i tshogs mchog dam pa khyad pa can gya nom pa phul du byung ba bla na med pa rgya che zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /bkur bstir bgyi'o/ /bla mar bgyi'o/ /mnyes par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gcig gam gsum sogs brjod kyang legs/ gnyis pa la bshags pa sogs bzhi las dang po ni/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum mam/ lan cig yin yang rung ste/ 'di ltar/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de dag thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan mchod pa'i gnas/ phyag bgyi ba'i gnas/ ri mor bgyi ba'i gnas/ mkhyen par gyur ba/ dbang du gyur ba/ tshad mar gyur ba/ mkhyen pa dang ldan pa/ gzigs pa dang ldan pa de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag thog ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis gzir te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis las kyi sgrib pa gang mngon par 'du bgyis pa sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang dge ba dngami dge ba ma 'tshal ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba dang*/ chos spangs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi dben byas pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang pha ma bkum pa dang*/

lus kyi gsum ngag gi bzhi yid kyi gsum ste mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal pa dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sems can kha cig la ngag rtsub po smras pa dang*/ skur ba btab pa dang*/ srang dang gzhal ba la g.yo bgyis pa dang*/ 'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba na pha ma mi dga' bar bgyis pa dang*/ gang zag gi'am mchod rten gyi'am dge 'dun gyi'am/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi nor brkus pa dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi ji ltar bcas pa rnams dang 'gal bar bgyis pa dang*/ mkhan slob kyis bsgo ba la ma nyan pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i sems can rnams la mi snyan par smras pa dang*/ spyos pa dang brdegs pa dang*/ de dag la tha ba dang zhe sdang bskyed pa dang phrag dog dang ser sna'i dbang gis sangs rgyas rnams la tshig rtsub po smras pa dang*/ chos la chos ma yin pa dang chos ma yin pa la chos lags zhes bgyis pa dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa gang gis bsgribs nas bdag sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags kyi yul dang*/ lha ma yin rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la mnyes par bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ mi khom pa rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i las kyi sgrib pa ji snyed byas pa dang byed bzhin pa dang byed par 'gyur ba thams cad kyang*/ sems can gzhan gyi las kyi sgrib pa dang lhan cig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mkhyen par gyur ba/ spyan du gyur ba/ dpang du gyur ba/ tshad mar gyur ba/ mkhyen pa dang ldan pa dang*/ gzigs pa dang ldan pa de dag gi spyan sngar so sor 'chags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab po/ slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /bdag mi khom par skye bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa de dag gi rnam par smin pa lus 'di nyid la smin te tshe rabs gzhan du mi myong bar shog cig

/ji ltar dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis byang chub kyi phyir spyod na las kyi sgrib pa rnams so sor bshags pa dang*/ 'chags pa 'gyur ba dang*/ ma bcabs pa dang*/ mi 'chabs pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang las kyi sgrib pa rnams so sor 'chags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos thams cad rten cing 'byung ba ste/ rgyu dang rkyen gzhan dang gzhan gyis gzhan skye'o/ /gzhan 'gag go /de la 'das pa'i chos gang yin pa de dag gi 'gag pa zad pa bral ba rnam par 'gyur ba/ 'du byed gang yin pa rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis stong ba las byung ba ste/ de dag la yang las kyi sgrib pa cung zad kyang med do/ /chos thams cad ngo bos stong ba/ bdag med pa/ sems can med pa/ srog med pa/ gang zag med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden pa des kyang*/ bdag gi las kyi sgrib pa rnams byang zhing zad par gyur cig /gnyis pa rjes su yi rang ba'i phung bo ni/ gzhan yang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na dus gsum gyi sems can gang su dag sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po mngon par 'du bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid par 'gyur ba thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa dang*/ bskal ba brgyas 'byung ba dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung bo gang lags pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa na pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed mngon par 'du bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid par 'gyur ba gang lags pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/

bskor bar 'gyur ba nas nyam bag tu spyod du btsud pa dang*/ 'dzud pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/ de la nyan thos gyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'am/ de las gzhan pa'i sems can rnams kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed par 'gyur ba gang lags pa thams cad la yang rjes su yi rang ba mchog gis rjes su yi rang ngo*/ / rjes su yi rang ba dam pa/ gtso bo/ khyad par can/ rab dang*/ phul dang*/ gya nom pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ bla na med pa dang*/ ltag na med pa dang*/ mnyam pa med pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams kyis rjes su yi rang bar gnang ba de ltar rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /gsum pa bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i phung bo ni/ gzhan yang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis skye bo mang bo la sman pa dang*/ skye bo mang bo la bde ba dang*/ skye bo mang bo la thugs brtse ba dang*/ skye bo phal po che dang*/ lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor tu gsol/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bstan du gsol/ chos kyi tshul rab tu bzung du gsol/ chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad du gsol/ chos kyi sgron me 'bar du gsol/ chos kyi char dbab tu gsol/ chos kyi rnga brdung du gsol/ chos kyi rnga bo che brdung du gsol/ chos kyi dung 'bud du gsol/ chos kyi srog shing bsgreng du gsol/ nyam bag tu spyod du 'dzud par mdzad du gsol lo/ /gang dag de ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na smra tshe'i 'du byed gtong bar bzhed pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs so/

/bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi skye bo mang bo la sman pa dang bde ba dang thugs brtse ba dang*/ lha dang mi rnams kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nas/ nyam bag tu spyod du 'dzud pa'i bar gyi phyir mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bzhi ba bsngo ba'i phung bo ni/ gzhan yang*/ bdag thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ dkon mchog gsum mam/ gang zag gzhan dang*/ tha na dud 'gro'i skyes gnas su song ba dag la yang zan chang gcig stsal ba dang*/ skyabs su song ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi yang dag par blangs pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa sgo gsum gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig mngon par 'du bgyis pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus gzhal bzlums te/ dul ba dang rnam par grol ba dang bzung ba ma mchis pa'i sems kyis sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis mkhyen cing gzigs nas dgongs pa ltar bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad la btang bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang lag na rin po che dang ldan par gyur cig /nam mkha'i mdzod dang longs spyod dang bsod nams dang chos dang ye shes dang spobs pa zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang thob par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad la btang ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsod nams gang mngon par 'du bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid par 'gyur ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus gzhal bzlums te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'i/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

/ji ltar sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub kyi phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngos pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsngo bar 'gyur ba dang*/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsngo bar mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rigs gang yin pa dang bzhin dang mtshan nyid dang chos nyid gang gis yongs su bsngo ba bla na med par 'gyur ba de ltar yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chags pa med pa brnyes nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te sems can rnams smin cing grol bar byed nus par gyur cig ces bya'o/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs dang*/ rmad byung sras bcas sogs kyang brjod do/ /de dag cung zad re 'bri bsnan ma gtogs mdo tshig bzhin no/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ mdo de nyid las/ shā ri'i bu de lta bas na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa rnam par dag pa thob par 'dod pas/ 'di bzhin du las kyi sgrib pa rnams so sor bshags par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal rigs dang rje rigs dang bram ze'i rigs dang khyim bdag gi rigs phyug cing nor mang ba longs spyod che ba rnams dang*/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang*/ gzugs khams kyi lhar skye ba dang*/ nyan thos dang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob par 'dod pas kyang las kyi sgrib pa rnams de ltar bshags par gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ shā ri'i bu 'di ni rjes su yi rang ba'i phung bo ste/

rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rjes su yi rang ba 'dis rjes su yi rang na bsod nams kyi phung bo dpag tu med pa bskyed do/ / shā ri'i bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can nam/ 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad dgra bcom pa zag pa zad par gyur la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig de dag la gos dang zas dang na ba'i gso sman dang yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ gang zhig rjes su yi rang ba 'dis rjes su yi rang na de ni bsod nams ches mang du grangs med dpag tu med pa bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid las/ shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams sam/ 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa ji snyed pa de dag rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dbul ba phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang gsol ba btab na/ de ni de bas kyang bsod nams ches grangs med dpag tu med pa bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ yang de nyid las/ shā ri'i bu 'di ni sngo ba'i phung bo ste/ bsod nams kyi phung bo snga mas bsod nams kyi phung bo 'di'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro bas nas dpe'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ lha'i dbang bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrub pa dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i gces spras byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams shes par bya'o/ /de ltar mdo'i don dang mthun par nyams su blangs na phan yon che bar bsams te/ mdo nas 'byung ba ltar shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i gzims khang nyid nas gus pas kun nas bslangs te nye bar bgyis pa'i yi ge la'ang rang nyid do/

/'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ las sgrib rgyun gcod kyi mdo don nyams su len tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 214-- PAGE 215-- PAGE 207-
